command_prefix:
import fcntl, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, stat, sys, types, unittest
p = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); raw = p.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == sys.argv[2]
a = json.loads(raw)
parent = lock = None
try:
    parent_path = os.path.dirname(a['coordination']['path'])
    parent = os.open(parent_path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC)
    def identity(s): return [s.st_dev, s.st_ino, s.st_uid, stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)]
    assert identity(os.fstat(parent)) == a['coordination']['parent_identity']
    lock = os.open('build.lock', os.O_RDWR | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC, dir_fd=parent)
    s = os.fstat(lock)
    assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_size == 0
    assert identity(s) + [s.st_nlink] == a['coordination']['identity']
    assert identity(os.stat(parent_path, follow_symlinks=False)) == a['coordination']['parent_identity']
    named = os.stat('build.lock', dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
    assert identity(named) + [named.st_nlink] == a['coordination']['identity'] and named.st_size == 0
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    fs = os.statvfs(p.parent)
    assert fs.f_bavail * fs.f_frsize >= a['resource_floor_bytes']
    for name, descriptor in [('screen_replacement', a['source']), ('screen_replacement_tests', a['fixture'])]:
        source = pathlib.Path(descriptor['path']).read_bytes()
        assert len(source) == descriptor['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest() == descriptor['sha256']
        module = types.ModuleType(name); module.__file__ = descriptor['path']; sys.modules[name] = module
        exec(compile(source, descriptor['path'], 'exec'), module.__dict__)
    suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromModule(module)
    assert suite.countTestCases() == 12
    result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
    print(json.dumps(dict(testsRun=result.testsRun, failures=len(result.failures), errors=len(result.errors), skipped=len(result.skipped), boundary='deterministic fake proc/pidfd only; zero application cases')))
    raise SystemExit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() and result.testsRun == 12 and not result.skipped else 1)
finally:
    try:
        if lock is not None: os.close(lock)
    finally:
        if parent is not None: os.close(parent)
